scope: Seller commission and payment processing on US Whatnot sales. State sales tax on fees, giveaways and promotional tiers are noted but not computed beyond the tier you select.
structure: Two fees are deducted per checkout transaction. Commission is a percentage of the item's final sale price (accepted offer/auction price after seller-generated coupons), excluding shipping and taxes: 8% in most US categories, 4% for Coins & Money (Coins & Bullion, Paper Money & Currency) and for the Pallets wholesale category (limited time). Payment processing is 2.9% of the total order value paid by the buyer at checkout (item + buyer-paid shipping + buyer-paid sales tax) plus a fixed $0.30 per transaction; it therefore varies with shipping and tax even for identical item prices. Since January 14, 2026, in select categories (Comics & Anime, Toys & Hobbies, Coins & Money, Trading Card Games, Entertainment Cards, Sports Singles subcategories, and from June 4, 2026 Bags & Accessories and Jewelry & Watches) the commission is 0% on the portion of an individual order's price above $1,500 while processing still applies to the full amount; sports breaks and surprise products are excluded. Net earnings = final sale price − commission − payment processing − any state tax on fees − any seller-covered shipping. Whatnot-issued coupons do not reduce the seller's price; giveaways carry no seller fees. The same schedule applies to live shows and marketplace (non-live) listings; for live sales the rate follows the show's category, for marketplace sales the product's category.
quotes: Comics, TCG, Sports Singles, Toys & Hobbies (see other restrictions) 8% on final sale price up to $1,500; 0% on portion above $1,500 (limited time; learn more). 2.9% on total order value + $0.30 transaction fee
Coins & Money 4% on final sale price up to $1,500; 0% on portion above $1,500 (limited time)** 2.9% on total order value + $0.30 transaction fee
Pallets (Wholesale category) 4% on final sale price (limited time) 2.9% on total order value + $0.30 transaction fee
All other categories (some restrictions apply) 8% on final sale price 2.9% on total order value + $0.30 transaction fee
*Plus applicable taxes on fees.
The commission fee is Whatnot’s share of the sale. It’s calculated as a percentage of your item’s final sale price, excluding shipping and taxes.
It’s calculated as a percentage of the total order value (the amount paid by the buyer at checkout), plus a fixed transaction fee.
Fees are automatically applied each time a buyer checks out. Even if purchases are later bundled into one order or shipment, fees are calculated separately per transaction.
Whatnot doesn’t charge fees to create, store, or manage listings.
Net earnings = Item's final sale price – commission fee – payment processing fee
Products properly listed under the following categories qualify for a 4% commission fee: Coins & Bullion Paper Money & Currency

Starting January 14, 2026, Whatnot began charging a 0% commission on the portion of the sale price over 1,500 (USD/AUD/EUR/GBP 1,500 or JPY 225,000) on individual orders in select categories plus standard payment processing.
Starting at 12:00am EST on June 4th, 2026, Whatnot extended this promotion to include individual orders in Bags & Accessories and Jewelry & Watches.
Rate only applies to the Singles subcategories in Sports Cards. Sports breaks and Surprise Products are excluded from the promotion.
For live sales: the rate is based on the category of the show. For marketplace (non-live) sales: the rate is based on the category of the product.
No. You aren't charged seller fees for Giveaways because the buyer doesn’t pay anything. You only pay for shipping.
Seller-generated coupons: Reduce the final sale price, so fees apply to the discounted amount.
If you cover part or all of the shipping cost, that amount is deducted from your earnings, along with applicable commission and payment processing fees.

notes: Live vs marketplace: the fee schedule does not differentiate live-show sales from marketplace (Buy It Now/offer) sales; the only stated difference is which category sets the rate (show category for live, product category for marketplace).

Trading cards: Trading Card Games, Entertainment Cards and Sports Singles have the standard 8% commission but qualify for the 0%-above-$1,500 promotion; sports breaks and Surprise Products do not. Coins & Money is the only permanently reduced category (4%); Pallets (wholesale) is 4% 'limited time'.

Electronics: the 'Reduced Commission on Electronics' article now returns 404 and Electronics is not a reduced row in the fee table; search-engine snippets citing a 5% electronics commission are stale/unverified. The snippet 'Seller fees are ≤8% (varies by category/country)' also comes from an older revision of the fee page.

The high-value 0% promotion has no stated end date ('limited time'; Whatnot may end it at any time). Sell More, Earn More is a US-only test for a subset of sellers through at least November 1, 2026; a calculator should treat tiered rates as optional/conditional.

Payment processing uses the buyer's total including sales tax, so an exact fee needs shipping and buyer tax as inputs; in Whatnot's own example 2.9% × $58.70 + $0.30 = $2.0023 is shown as $2.00 (rounded to cents).

Taxes on fees: sellers in DC, HI, NM, WV pay state sales tax on the commission; sellers in CT (special 1% rate), HI, NM, OH, SD, TX (rate reduced by 20%), WV pay it on the payment-processing fee; these are deducted from earnings.
Premier Shop discount (10% off the commission) is mentioned only in the Sell More, Earn More FAQ; eligibility terms were not on the loaded pages.
summary: Whatnot takes an 8% commission on the item's final price (4% on coins and money) and 2.9% + 30¢ payment processing on the buyer's total including shipping and tax. In trading cards, comics, toys and several collectible categories the commission is 0% on the portion above $1,500 since January 2026.

examples.description: Whatnot's own example: a $50 item with a $58.70 checkout total pays $4.00 commission (8%) and $2.00 processing (2.9% + $0.30 on $58.70) — $6.00 in fees, leaving $44.00.
examples.quote: Final sale price: $50 Commission (8%): $4 Total order value (including shipping and taxes): $58.70 Payment processing fee (2.9% of $58.70 + $0.30): $2.00 Your net earnings: $50 − $4 − $2 = $44.00

examples.description: Whatnot's own high-value example: a $2,000 item in a qualifying category pays commission on the first $1,500 only — $120.
examples.quote: You are US-based seller who sells an item in a qualifying category for $2,000 You will be charged standard commission (for the US, 8%) on the first $1,500. Your total commission fee will be $120. You will be charged 0% commission on the remaining $500 Payment processing fees on the full transaction value still apply. In the US, this number is 2.9% + $0.30
